intent: Individual reading-aloud preparation preserves the exact original dialogue, distinguishes proposed and agreed times, practises intact sense groups and separates actual recording/self-listening from typed preparation and unapproved audio.
picturePurpose: Exact coded time comparison and sense-group choices support the auditory information task without decorative scenes or generated timestamps. No pronunciation or listening credit from text controls.

workshop.title: 看清改约信息，把原台词读完整
workshop.instruction: 这里保存的是朗读准备笔记，不改写原对话。先核对改约时间与地点，再保留完整意群，最后真正开口并回听。配套音频待批准后才能跟读；当前不提供发音评分。

items.label: 三点提议 → 四点半约定
items.prompt: 读完整段对话，最后约定什么时候、在哪里等？
items.reason: 时间与地点已核对。实际朗读时把half past four和library door读完整；选择正确不等于发音已检查。
items.hint: at three是最初提议；Ben那时有音乐课，改提half past four，Mia接受。前面的four只是另一道练习的示例，不能替换这段原台词。本卡用12小时制标示，不推断上午或下午。
items.material:
读下面的简短对话，可以分别读两个人的台词。录音后检查信息是否读完整、停顿是否自然、自己能否听清。配套音频就绪后可以先听再跟读；现在也可以先朗读自查。
原对话：
Mia: Shall we meet at the library at three?
Ben: I have a music lesson then. Could we meet at half past four instead?
Mia: That works for me. I'll wait by the library door.

composeBrief.title: 提议 → 改约 → 接受
composeBrief.hint: 读原对话，不把最初提议当作最后约定。
composeBrief.wrong: half past four是四点半，不是四点，也不是最后仍三点。Mia在图书馆门口等，不是音乐教室或体育馆后面。

items.label: 意群保留完整，不逐词硬切
items.prompt: 怎样按意思读清问句中的新时间？
items.reason: 示例意群已核对。实际读时自然停顿，不要求每个斜线处必须停，也不逐词用同样的力气。
items.hint: 斜线只是可选的练习分组，不是原台词的新标点。half past four表示同一个时间，不能为了停顿把它机械切碎。
items.material:

原对话：
Mia: Shall we meet at the library at three?
Ben: I have a music lesson then. Could we meet at half past four instead?
Mia: That works for me. I'll wait by the library door.

composeBrief.title: 一个时间，一个完整意群
composeBrief.hint: 理解问句是在提出改约，再读清完整的新时间。
composeBrief.wrong: half past four是完整时间短语，不能拆碎或漏掉past。重音要突出新时间，不是所有词一样重；也不要求复制单一口音。

fields.label: 哪种练习分组保留时间短语？

choices.label: Could we meet at half / past / four instead?
Could we meet / at half past four instead?
Could we meet at four instead?

fields.label: 改约时应该让听者听清什么？

choices.label: The complete new time: half past four.
Force every word equally and ignore the changed time.
Copy one particular accent perfectly or count it as failure.

items.label: 实际朗读后，再回听检查
items.prompt: 怎样检查刚才的朗读，而不是只检查文字？
items.reason: 朗读自查步骤已核对。还需要实际开口和回听；这里只记录准备，不自动判断清晰度或发音。
items.hint: 没有配套音频也能先朗读原对话并回听自己的录音。批准音频就绪后再跟读；不把文字点选、打字或某种口音当成发音测评。

composeBrief.title: 读完整 → 回听 → 再读一次
composeBrief.hint: 先做真实朗读，再检查漏词、时间地点与自然停顿。
composeBrief.wrong: 看懂台词或选对答案不能证明发音准确；删词提速也不合要求。准备卡不提供官方评分、满分保证或已听批准音频的记录。

fields.label: 哪种检查针对实际朗读？

choices.label: Only look at the words and assume every sound was clear.
Read aloud, record it, and listen for complete key words and natural pauses.
Read faster by leaving out half past four.

fields.label: 完成这些准备卡后，能说明什么？

choices.label: The app has officially measured my pronunciation and guaranteed full marks.
I have checked my preparation; I still need actual reading and self-listening.
I have automatically listened to approved model audio.

transfer.stem: Which reading plan preserves this new dialogue and checks actual speech?
transfer.passage:
A different dialogue: an afternoon meeting
A: Shall we meet at the hall at two?
B: My club finishes then. Could we meet at quarter past two instead?
A: Yes, I will wait by the hall door.

Read the original lines aloud. Check the agreed time and place, complete key words and natural pauses. Looking at a written plan does not measure pronunciation.

options.text: Read only the original two o’clock suggestion and omit the agreed new time.
Change quarter past two to quarter to two and claim they mean the same thing.
Read every word with identical force, omit the place and count looking at the text as a pronunciation test.
Keep the original dialogue, read the agreed quarter past two and hall door clearly, then record and check complete words and natural pauses.

answer.display: Keep the original dialogue, read the agreed quarter past two and hall door clearly, then record and check complete words and natural pauses.

explanation.strategy: 先理解新的改约信息，再保持原台词并检查实际朗读。

steps.text: 先提两点，后改为quarter past two并被接受：最后是14:15，在礼堂门口等。
steps.reason: quarter past two是两点一刻；不能照搬图书馆对话的四点半。

steps.text: 把时间和地点读完整，实际录音后回听漏词与自然停顿。
steps.reason: 文字准备不能代替发音证据，也不要求复制一种固定口音。

distractors.reason: 漏掉已接受的新时间，信息仍停在最初提议。
quarter past two是14:15，quarter to two是13:45，不能互换。
省略地点和逐词同等用力不利于理解；看文字也不是发音测评。

explanation.pitfall: 知道最初的时间，却漏读后面修改并接受的新时间。

visual.title: 新对话：14:00 → 14:15
visual.caption: 保持原台词；点选正确不等于已经发音准确。

explanation.transfer: 如果回听发现漏掉past，怎样重新读清整个时间短语？
